content:
alex_cs: Customer 'LumenHealth' hitting preflight 429s during deploy warmup. They spawn ~40 parallel workers.

nina_eng: Likely token stampede. Quick checklist: increase ephemeral TTL for warmup, add jitter on init, throttle concurrent preflights in SDK, respect Retry-After.

alex_cs: They shared this snippet — no jitter, TTL=20s: 
```js
await initClient({ ephemeralTokenTTL: 20 });
```

nina_eng: Recommend: TTL=120 (temp), set maxConcurrentPreflights=2, start with setTimeout(random 0-3s). Also backoff on 401 before retry.

ops-oncall: We can apply a 4-hour quota bump. Please confirm when patched and we27ll monitor.

alex_cs: Customer to patch now, will redeploy in ~30m. Will update thread when green. :thumbsup:
